text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

TAPICOA SALE - South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation on Tuesday bought 10,000 tonnes of Thai tapioca hard pellet at $87.50 a tonne from Soon Hwa Seng, an NLCF official said. The official said it passed on tenders to buy 40,000 tonnes of tapioca hard pellet and 30,000 tonnes of wheat bran pellet or rice bran pellet due to high offer prices.

FLOUR TENDER - Yemen has launched a May 13 import tender for 150,000 tonnes of soft wheat flour, European traders said. The tender calls for shipment between August and October and the flour is expected to come from the European Union, the United States or both, they said.

WHEAT TENDERS - Sri Lanka seeks 100,000 tonnes HRW wheat. The first shipment was for May 22-June 5 if from the U.S., Canada, Europe or Argentina, and June 10-19 from Australia or Saudi Arabia. The second shipment was for June 16-25 if from U.S., Canada, the Continent or Argentina, and June 30-July 9 from Australia or Saudi Arabia.
WHEAT TENDER - Pakistan will receive offers in its tender for about 330,000 tonnes of soft white wheat on Tuesday, according to a Pakistan embassy official and several U.S. exporters.

"We are receiving the offers tomorrow (Tuesday)," the embassy official said. The amount was about 330,000 tonnes, he said. Delivery on the optional origin wheat would be for May 20-June 10, exporters and the embassy said.
SUNOIL TENDER - The CCC will tender on May 7 for 3,000 tonnes of U.S. crude sunflower seed oil for export to Mozambique, June 1-20 shipment.
RICE TENDERS - Jordan seeks 15,000 tonnes of medium grain camolina type rice for delivery in June.
- Jamaica was tendering for about 3,000 tonnes U.S. rice in bulk under the PL-480 donation program, its U.S. export agent said. The delivery date was set for May 20-June 5.
- Costa Rican millers were privately negotiating with exporters on Tuesday for 26,500 tonnes of optional origin long grain rough rice, for June 30-July 7 shipment.

SOYBEAN TENDER - Taiwan is expected to tender for 54,000 tonnes of soybeans this week while demand for corn will remain sluggish following the outbreak in March of hog foot-and-month disease, traders said.

SOYMEAL TENDER - El Salvador was retendering for about 8,000 to 10,000 tonnes of U.S. soybean meal in bulk under the PL-480 export program, its U.S. export agent said. The soymeal was set for June 1-15 delivery. Offers were to be submitted no later than May 12 and will be valid until May 13.
MARKET TALK - The Thai cabinet was to consider on Tuesday a proposal to cut the soymeal tariff to five percent from the current 10 percent, a commerce ministry official said.
The move to cut soymeal tariffs came after the feed industry urged the government to remove the 10 percent import duty on soymeal, saying the soaring price of soymeal has driven up production costs.
... South Korea's National Agricultural Cooperative Federation has asked local feed millers to delay their requests to raise feed prices, but the millers are balking, traders said.
... India may import 400,000 tonnes of sunseed oil in the 1996/97 (Oct/Sept) season compared with 116,000 tonnes in the previous season, the independent Oil World newsletter said.
